content: Setlist builder apps (Setlist Helper, Set List Maker, All Set) standardize on drag-handle reordering with running total set-time updating live as songs are reordered/added. General drag-and-drop UX best practice: visible drag handle, elevate/shadow the dragged item, snap-to-place animation (~100ms), haptic feedback on pick-up (mobile), keyboard-accessible alternative (arrow keys) for a11y.
